title: AbbVie Is Already a Dividend King. Here's Why the $10.9 Billion Apogee Deal Could Make It a Dynasty
title_zh: 艾伯维（AbbVie）已经是股息之王。这就是为什么 109 亿美元的 Apogee 交易可以使其成为一个王朝
summary: AbbVie inherited its status as a Dividend King, but it is building a strong foundation to continue the dividend streak.
summary_zh: 艾伯维继承了股息之王的地位，但它正在为继续股息增长奠定坚实的基础。

title: Broadcom Lands $30 Billion Chip Deal With Apple. Why It’s a Win-Win for AAPL and AVGO.
title_zh: Broadcom 与 A​​pple 达成价值 300 亿美元的芯片交易。为什么这对 AAPL 和 AVGO 来说是双赢的。
summary: Broadcom strengthened its growth outlook by securing a $30 billion chip agreement with Apple through 2031.
summary_zh: Broadcom 与 A​​pple 签订了到 2031 年价值 300 亿美元的芯片协议，增强了其增长前景。

title: Microsoft's retirement offer is a wake-up call for workers
title_zh: 微软的退休优惠给员工敲响了警钟
summary: About 8,750 Microsoft employees recently had roughly 30 days to decide whether their savings could support walking away from their careers for good.
summary_zh: 大约 8,750 名微软员工最近有大约 30 天的时间来决定他们的积蓄是否足以支持永远放弃自己的职业生涯。

title: Apollo Gatecrashes easyJet’s Takeover Flight
title_zh: 阿波罗计划破坏了易捷航空的收购航班
summary: The US buyout giant has topped Castlelake’s offer with a £5.7 billion proposal, turning easyJet from budget airline into premium bidding-war cargo.
summary_zh: 这家美国收购巨头以 57 亿英镑的报价超越了 Castlelake 的报价，将易捷航空从廉价航空公司转变为优质的竞购战货运航空公司。

title: Apollo hijacks easyJet takeover with £5.7bn bid, trumping Castlelake
title_zh: 阿波罗以 57 亿英镑的出价击败卡斯尔莱克，劫持易捷航空收购
summary: The budget airline easyJet has swung behind a £5.7 billion (€6.6bn) takeover proposal from the US private equity giant Apollo, abandoning its support for a rival American bidder days after agreeing to that offer.View on euronews
summary_zh: 廉价航空公司易捷航空 (easyJet) 转而支持美国私募股权巨头阿波罗 (Apollo) 的 57 亿英镑（66 亿欧元）收购提议，并在同意该提议几天后放弃了对美国竞争对手的支持。
